summary.headline: Twelve-Year Cycles and Palchus
summary.text: Catalog entries for astrological twelve-year cycles in manuscripts from Vienna, Turin, Naples, and Angelicum, including Apomasar, Orpheus, Valens, Jupiter’s cycle, and references to Ptolemy, Salmasius, and Cleomedes. The page then introduces Palchus’s chapter on the twelve signs and four seasons, correlating signs and seasonal solstices with hot, cold, wet, or dry years.
